[CarbonTimer: Overcoming data scarcity in carbon price forecasting with a large time series model](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jclepro.2026.149247)– Meiqin Jiang, Jinxing Che, Yaoxin Tan, Wei Dong
Jiang, Che, Tan, and Dong forecast carbon prices in China’s emissions trading system, with its small samples and high volatility, by fine-tuning Timer, a large time series model, on carbon market data. CarbonTimer keeps the general temporal feature extraction of the large model and adds a dedicated focus on carbon prices, with a feature selection mechanism and a multi-task forecasting framework. On the Guangdong and Hubei markets it cuts mean squared error by an average of 29.5% relative to Qwen2 for single-step forecasts and, for multi-step forecasts, by more than 40% relative to LSTM models, and the model tracks the dynamic correlation between carbon prices and financial indices.
